headline: BANYAN GOLD DRILLS 149 G/T AU BONANZA IN YUKON — 52.8M AT 1.05 G/T AU ADDS BULK TO 8.6MOZ AURMAC SYSTEM
snippet: Banyan Gold (TSXV: BYN) reported September 17 that hole AX-26-892B returned 1.05 g/t gold over 52.8 metres and hole AX-26-891 hit 149.14 g/t Au over 0.4 metres within a broader zone of 0.56 g/t Au over 169.2 metres at the western Powerline Deposit of the AurMac Project in Yukon — the bonanza-grade intercept confirming high-grade pods within a bulk-tonnage system already hosting an 8.6 million ounce resource (3.64 Moz Indicated, 4.99 Moz Inferred); the results extend the known mineralized footprint westward and the drill program continues to target resource conversion and delineation.

headline: NEXUS MINERALS DOUBLES WALLBROOK GOLD 108% TO 631,000oz — 13MT AT 1.5 G/T IN WA, PROCESSING STUDY LAUNCHED
snippet: Nexus Minerals (ASX: NXM) announced September 17 a 108% increase in its Wallbrook Gold Project Mineral Resource Estimate in Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields — growing from 304,000 ounces (5.67 Mt at 1.7 g/t) to 631,000 ounces (13.34 Mt at 1.5 g/t, with 207,000 oz Indicated and 424,000 oz Inferred) — bringing the company's total group resources to 709,000 ounces including the Pinnacles Deposit; Mincore Engineering has been engaged for a processing plant sizing study and a diamond drilling program is planned for October 2026 to convert Inferred to Indicated classification.

headline: AGC DRILLS 17M AT 5.3 G/T AU + 163 G/T AG AT NSW EVERGREEN — SECOND MAJOR POLYMETALLIC DISCOVERY IN TWO YEARS
snippet: Australian Gold & Copper (ASX: AGC) confirmed a high-grade polymetallic discovery at the Evergreen prospect within its South Cobar Project in New South Wales — hole 26DDBR017 returned 17 metres at 5.3 g/t Au, 163 g/t Ag, 0.8% Cu, and 17.3% combined Pb+Zn from 128 metres, including 8 metres at 10.4 g/t Au and 311 g/t Ag from 129 metres; management described the intercept as a 'discovery hole' and the company's second significant gold-silver-base metals find in two years, with 7,000 metres of resource definition drilling now underway toward a maiden MRE.

headline: TROILUS Z87 HITS 3.38 G/T AUEQ OVER 22M WITHIN 129M — NEW HANGINGWALL ZONE FOUND OUTSIDE CURRENT RESOURCE MODEL
snippet: Troilus Mining (TSX: TLG) released its fourth batch of Z87 optimization drill results at the Troilus Gold-Copper Project in north-central Quebec on September 17, with hole 87-26-515 returning 3.38 g/t AuEq (2.97 g/t Au, 1.80 g/t Ag, 0.29% Cu) over 22 metres within a broader 129-metre envelope at 0.95 g/t AuEq; separately, the same hole encountered mineralized intervals in a historically unsampled Z87 hangingwall area where the current resource model contains no mineralized blocks — suggesting meaningful upside to the mine plan presented in the company's September 9 Technical Report.

headline: PROSPECT RESOURCES SCORES TWO COPPER FINDS AT MUMBEZHI IN ONE RELEASE — SHARAMBA NEW DISCOVERY SPANS 3KM+ IN ZAMBIA
snippet: Prospect Resources (ASX: PSC) confirmed two copper discoveries in a single September 17 update from its 208.1 Mt Mumbezhi Copper Project in Zambia — a brand-new Sharamba discovery 10 km northeast of Nyungu Central with maiden drill intercepts extending over 3 km of structural strike, plus infill drilling at Nyungu Central returning 27 metres at 0.69% Cu from 102 metres and 5.1 metres at 0.99% Cu from 173 metres; assays for 20 Phase 3 priority holes remain outstanding, with results expected to further define the scale of both discoveries.

headline: SENTINEL METALS CONFIRMS 48M STACKED GOLD ZONES AT COLUMBIA — FIRE ASSAYS ADD 12.1 G/T HIGH-GRADE SPIKE TO 920KOZ PROJECT
snippet: Sentinel Metals (ASX: SNM) reported September 17 fire assay results for diamond holes DDCO26-002, -003, and -004 at its Columbia Gold-Silver Project in Montana — hole DDCO26-003 returned 48 metres at 1.13 g/t Au across multiple stacked zones from 18 metres depth, including 6.1 metres at 3.50 g/t Au and a high-grade spike of 1.5 metres at 12.1 g/t Au; the results build on a 920,000-ounce Inferred Resource with an updated MRE incorporating all 2026 drilling targeted for November 2026, while the company's combined North American portfolio now approaches 2 million ounces following the August completion of its Big Springs, Nevada acquisition.

headline: KITCO: HISTORY SAYS BUY GOLD AFTER THE FIRST FED HIKE — POSITIVE RETURNS IN EVERY CYCLE SINCE 1973
snippet: Kitco's September 17 analysis examines gold's historical performance following each Federal Reserve first-hike-in-a-new-cycle going back to 1973, finding consistent positive returns within 12 months regardless of the rate trajectory that followed, and argues that Wednesday's 25bp increase to 3.75%-4.00% marks a similar inflection point — with the market having already absorbed the hike while holding the $4,300 floor, suggesting the institutional rotation into miners and bullion is ahead rather than behind the current price action.

headline: LEGACY MINERALS ADDS SCANDIUM TO 167MT NICO RESOURCE — WSP ENGAGED FOR OCTOBER 2026 MULTI-METAL MRE IN NSW
snippet: Legacy Minerals (ASX: LGM) has engaged WSP Australia to complete an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for its NiCo Young Nickel-Cobalt-Scandium Project near Wallendbeen in New South Wales, adding discrete near-surface scandium domains to a 167.8 Mt resource already carrying 996,700 tonnes of contained nickel and 96,600 tonnes of cobalt; with results expected in October 2026, the inclusion of scandium — a critical mineral used in aerospace alloys and solid oxide fuel cells — expands the project's multi-commodity profile and commercial optionality at a time of growing Western demand for non-Chinese critical mineral supply.

headline: NEW ATHABASCA ENTRANT PURECORE METALS LAUNCHES DATA REVIEW AT YURCHISON — BASIN-WIDE URANIUM HUNT EXPANDS
snippet: Purecore Metals, a new entrant to Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin, announced September 17 the launch of a technical data review at the Yurchison Project — digitizing historical records and reinterpreting older and newer geophysical surveys to establish field priorities — as uranium spot held near US$89.95 per pound and long-term contract benchmarks reached US$95.50 per pound; the company's option on the asset follows a pattern of new capital entering the Basin as the World Nuclear Association projects global reactor requirements to climb from 68,920 tU in 2025 to over 150,000 tU by 2040.
